source.generator: F124AG semantic paired two-error noise with independently fresh salted FIT and DEV populations; no F124AG samples or pretrained tuning
source.semantic_truth: two one-bit mismatches on public path, same bit index positive, different bit indexes negative

models.fingerprint: Trainable 16-position scalar codebook learned from FIT labeled public pairs. First mismatched bit identity encoded by its learned codebook scalar in the EXISTING cell.score; second mismatch retrieves code and classifies by squared distance with FIT-frozen threshold; two hops may be separated by arbitrary intervening exact transitions. Keep existing original node/raw16/score cell payload, seven active and nine retained maximum, no additional persistent state.
models.algorithm: Unconstrained logistic SGD on scalar difference-square for positive same-bit vs negative different-bit, initial per-bit codes seed fixed, train 100 epochs on all FIT pairs in deterministic order; code gradient clipped to +/-1 per update and codes projected [-2,2]; trainable scalar decision threshold FIT-selected from [0.0001,0.001,0.01,0.04,0.09,0.16,0.25,0.49] maximizing FIT pair count with zero FIT false positives, tie smallest threshold; DEV has zero tuning.
models.initialized_codebook: Deterministic xorshift hash signed floats approx [-0.015,0.015], trainable all 16 codes; no secret labels in inference.
models.source_oracle_in_training: FIT labels allow supervised extraction of the public near-tolerant path for training ONLY; no FIT or DEV source semantic oracle called in inference

scientific.primary: Trained compact fingerprint improves exact paired correctness over historically frozen O/U on each fresh DEV family, with zero false-positive negatives; must also report comparison against successful fixed consistency16 and untrained codebook. Equal performance with simpler fixed comparator is NOT learned superiority.
